fluff.overview: The Kheper is a fifty-five-ton medium BattleMech secretly developed in the mid-thirty-second century by the Blessed Order, a renegade faction within ComStar led by Malcolm Buhl. Designed as a frontline combatant for the clandestine resurrection of the Com Guard's First Division, the 'Mech was manufactured by the New Earth Trading Company, a corporate front operated by ComStar since the early Succession Wars. Production began around 3135, with construction lines concealed among NETC's extensive civilian manufacturing operations on New Earth. The Kheper was engineered as a versatile generalist intended for ease of maintenance and logistical simplicity, and it has since gone on to serve multiple masters as control of its production facility has changed hands.
fluff.capabilities:
Built around a Core Tek 275 XL engine mounted in a NETC Kappa endo steel frame, the Kheper achieves a respectable top speed of eighty-six kilometers per hour for a fifty-five-ton design. Nine tons of Wall Type 8 light ferro-fibrous armor provide solid protection while maintaining the design's emphasis on weight efficiency, and CASE II systems in the right arm and left torso safeguard against catastrophic ammunition detonation.

The Kheper's weapons suite reflects its generalist philosophy, covering engagement ranges from long to close quarters. An M-7 Gauss rifle mounted in one arm serves as the primary weapon, delivering devastating kinetic impacts at range, while a Holly multi-missile launcher in the opposing arm provides flexible fire support with both long-range and short-range missile loads. For closer engagements, a Martell extended range medium laser and Martell-X medium X-pulse laser deliver concentrated energy fire, supplemented by a Blankenburg small variable-speed pulse laser for point defense and anti-infantry work.

The absence of jump jets represents the design's primary limitation, restricting the Kheper's tactical flexibility in broken or urban terrain where vertical mobility would otherwise allow it to exploit cover and elevation advantages.
fluff.history:
The Kheper's origins trace to a crucial moment in the twilight of ComStar's existence as a military power. In 3128, agents of the Blessed Order infiltrated a Republic of the Sphere data depot on Terra and stole advanced technical specifications from the Word of Blake's Manei Domini program, including extensive data on the Celestial series OmniMechs. Malcolm Buhl, the Blessed Order's leader, commissioned the New Earth Trading Company to develop new BattleMech designs from this stolen data, exploiting NETC's long history as a ComStar-controlled corporate front to conceal military production within the company's vast civilian manufacturing operations.

The Kheper and its heavier counterpart, the Uraeus, were the primary fruits of this clandestine program. The Com Guard's rebuilt First Division deployed both designs as core components when it took the field, fighting alongside the division until its final engagement against the Republic Armed Forces on Epsilon Eridani. The Com Guards' defeat there brought the Kheper to the Republic's attention, and the subsequent seizure of NETC's New Earth facilities placed the production line firmly under RAF control. The Republic nationalized the company, folding Kheper production into its own military infrastructure.

Re-staffed under new management, NETC continued producing the Kheper for the Republic Armed Forces. RAF strategists quickly recognized the design's value for raiding operations beyond the Fortress Republic's walls, as the 'Mech's obscurity meant opponents had virtually no intelligence on its capabilities. The Kheper proved a popular machine among raiding parties, its straightforward construction keeping it operational even during extended deployments far from Republic supply lines.

NETC's New Earth facility has a long and complex ownership history stretching back to the Star League era, when it operated under the Terran Hegemony. The factory passed through independent control during the early Succession Wars before being absorbed into the Lyran Commonwealth and later the Federated Commonwealth. The Word of Blake seized the facility during the Jihad, and though it was believed destroyed during New Earth's liberation in 3078, the factory was rebuilt under Republic of the Sphere control. With the collapse of Fortress Republic and the rise of the ilClan era, the facility and its Kheper production line have passed into the hands of Clan Jade Falcon, ensuring this once-secret design continues to see service under new masters.
fluff.deployment: This variant is the sole production variant of the Kheper. The design entered service with the Com Guard's rebuilt First Division and saw its first combat during operations on Epsilon Eridani. Following the Republic Armed Forces' acquisition of the production line, this variant proved well suited to the RAF's operational needs, where its straightforward maintenance requirements and reliance on widely sourced parts kept it operational during extended deployments far from established supply lines. No additional factory variants have been produced.
